EARLIER SCENES (context only):
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。
比方说，他一次试一试有些植物的叶，吃得又新鲜又甜。煮这些叶以后，他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶。虽然他找到了很多的新的植物，但是他的旅程有的时候特别是危险。比方说，他一吃灵芝就开始生病。
CURRENT SCENE:
一个爬山的男人正好看到神农的麻烦，然后给了他一些药。神农最终他的小镇回到，跟别的人分享他的发现。你认为神农的故事真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P229] 神农最终【他的小镇回到】
  proposed by the AI checker: 神农最终[他的小镇回到→回到他的小镇] (word order with 回到 is incorrect)
  proposed by the correction model: 神农最终[+回到]他的小镇回到
  proposed by the correction model: 神农最终他的小镇[-回到]
  her past correction (directional_complements): 神农[回→回到]他的家
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 神农回[-他的]家 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (redundant_words): 神农一走路就[-走]到了
  rule card directional_complements: Use V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去: put the place after the directional complement and before 来/去. For walking to a place, use 走到place来/去, not 走去 or 走来Place. Not an error: Do not treat 拿起来 and 拿上去 as interchangeable word-order forms: 拿起来 means “pick up,” while 拿上去 means “bring it up.”
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P230] 跟【别的人】分享他的发现
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 跟[-别的人]分享他的发现 (her pattern: 别的人 -> (delete) (corrected 8/8 in train))
  her past correction (other_vs_additional): 告诉[别的人→其他人] — her note: “别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [结果他→所以，]取得生活经验 — her note: “结果” for unexpected result
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 原来他想给[别的人→别人]建议
  rule card other_vs_additional: 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人. Not an error: Do not flag 别的 when it means a different type or all others except the one already mentioned.
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).

[P231] 你认为神农的故事【^】真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处
  proposed by the AI checker: 你认为神农的故事[+是]真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处 (是 is needed before the adjective question)
  proposed by the correction model: 你认为神农的故事[+是]真的吗？这就要看你相信中药对身体有好处
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 所以神农去找[一些植物，对身体有好处→一些对身体有好处的植物]
  her past correction (le_completed): 神农[身体好的以后→身体好了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 这是[一个神农的→关于神农的]古代故事
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

  her past correction (perception_look_see): 神农[一看→一看到]朋友就想找药 — her note: 看look vs.看到see

  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

places.reason: Use the fixed expression 别人.
是 is needed before 真的吗.
看 means “depends on” here, not visual perception.
是否 is optional after 看.
